prompt:
Use the attached image as the reference: the same woman — the personification of Californium (Cf) — seen off duty in her everyday life. Keep her face, eye colour, hair colour, skin tone and body exactly; change only her clothes, pose and place. Do not reuse earlier conversation images.

Output: one horizontal 3:2 image, 1536×1024.

Face: exactly the attached image's face — the same short midface and face length-to-width ratio; the camera angle, pose, bangs or a headpiece never make her face look longer or her jaw heavier.

Style: A Japanese anime key visual with a painterly finish: an anime-style character with an elegant adult anime face, large expressive eyes, a small nose and mouth, fine coloured linework and soft cel-to-painted shading with painted highlights in the hair and fabric. Behind her, a richly painted background with layered painterly colour, subtle visible brushwork, atmospheric perspective and cinematic depth. Luminous, rich colours; crisp focal details on the face and costume, softer painted edges toward the distance. No flat single-tone cel shading, photographic appearance, semi-realistic face or plastic 3D-render finish. Keep this rendering exactly as in the attached image — the same finish, line, shading, skin and colour treatment.

Place: a garden with a pond in her element's kingdom
Time of day: midday — bright even light; hard bright sun, crisp short shadows on the ground.
Hair: her hair in a single loose braid over one shoulder — same colour and length as the attached image.
Outfit: a chunky knit cardigan over a matching ribbed knit bralette top and soft knit shorts, with wool socks — in deep sapphire blue; the outfit colour reads clearly at first glance; styled with a small jewelled hair clip, showing her shoulders, collarbones and legs as far as the outfit allows, following her curvy figure — a slim waist and rounded hips; intimate areas covered.
POSTURE: lying on her front.
SUPPORT: she lies on her front, propped on her forearms.
COMPOSITION: a chest-up shot of her face, shoulders and expression; body facing the camera; head facing the camera straight on, both ears about equally visible; camera low, near the ground — level with her face when she sits, kneels or lies on the floor or a bed, looking up at her when she stands; a wall or backdrop of the place close behind her; her head and body angles are set by this line, not taken from the attached image.
Lens / perspective: 85mm-equivalent short-telephoto perspective from a suitable distance, with gentle background compression.
BOTH HANDS: both hands cup her chin, her forearms propped beneath her.
GAZE: she looks into the camera.
EXPRESSION: slightly drawn brow, narrowed steady eyes, mouth firmly closed.

Framing: a chest-up shot — the bottom edge crosses just below her bust; waist, hips and legs are out of frame.

Leave behind everything she wears in the attached image — no crown, tiara, helmet, feathers, headpiece, hairpins from it, armour or regalia; her hair is styled for the everyday outfit, with at most one small accessory.

Her element — californium: a silvery synthetic metal first made in 1950 by striking curium with alpha particles, and named for the golden western land and university where she was born, a land itself named after a legendary island of gold at the western edge of the world, ruled by a queen of warrior women armed in gold; one of her forms splits apart on its own, so a single microgram pours out over two million neutrons every second, an invisible spray used to kindle new nuclear reactors, to find hidden veins of gold and silver and pockets of oil deep underground, to spot concealed explosives and to fight cancer, and a single gram of her is worth tens of millions — may show in the outfit's details, motifs or small accessories.

Figure: strong and broad-shouldered with firm muscle, yet full-busted with wide rounded hips and a defined waist — keep this exact build from the attached image, neither slimmer nor fuller.

Light: the place's own light, lit and coloured the way this style renders light and skin.

One figure in focus, natural hands with five fingers, no text or numbers other than her element's own symbol and atomic number, no logo or watermark. No animals or other creatures.
